content:
alex: Heads-up: small set of requests intended for v2 dropped to v1 during yesterday's rate-cap window. Noticed via alerting.
nina: Do we have the router logs?
raj: Snippet: [2025-04-11T19:10:02Z] req=abc route=proj/x variant=v2 status=THROTTLED fallback=proj/x:v1 reason=RATE_CAP decision=sticky_match -> selected=proj/x:v1
nina: That indicates precedence bug: sticky_match winning over explicit fallback on rate cap.
alex: Proposal: change router precedence so explicit fallback wins when reason==RATE_CAP, emit metric `route.fallback` with tags {route,from,to,reason,tenant}.
raj: I'll open a small hotfix PR and add unit tests to simulate throttle+sticky. Feature-flag it for quick rollback.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: raj/router-fallback-fix -> canary at 2025-04-12T03:00:00Z.
nina: Also add a console tiny tile "Fallbacks (rate cap)" and a banner in incident view. Keep telemetry low-cardinality and sample traces.
alex: Action owners: raj=PR+tests (ETA: today), nina=console mock+metric tile (ETA: tomorrow), alex=support search for prior tickets (ETA: today).
